sentences.text:
Bench: B.S. Verma
Wpms No.2209 of 2013
Hon'ble B.S. Verma, J.
Mr. Navneet Kaushik, Advocate for petitioner.
Mr. Rajesh Sharma, Brief Holder for respondent nos.1 to 3.

This writ petition has been filed for quashing of impugned order dated 13.08.2013 passed by respondent no.1 in case no.1/2013 Food Safety Officer, Laksar vs. Sunil Kumar Bansal and others (annexure no.7 to the writ petition) whereby penalty of Rs.1.00 Lakhs has been imposed upon the petitioner u/s 51 and 54 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has firstly contended that without proof of sale of sugar to respondent no.4 the Adjudicating Officer has wrongly imposed penalty upon the petitioner.
Learned counsel has secondly contended that report of Food Analyst does not indicate what extraneous matter was found in the sugar.
Issue notice to respondent no.4 returnable within four weeks.

entities.text: case no.1/2013 Food Safety Officer, Laksar vs. Sunil Kumar Bansal and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The respondents shall file counter affidavit within four weeks.
Thereafter, two weeks' time is allowed to the petitioner to file rejoinder affidavit.
Also heard on the stay application no.9748 of 2013.

Having considered the submissions of learned for the petitioner, as an interim measure, it is directed that if the petitioner deposits entire amount of penalty with the Registry of this Court within four weeks from today the execution of the impugned order shall remain stayed.

(B.S. Verma, J.) 10.09.2013 Rajni Hon'Ble B.S. Verma vs Sunil Kumar Bansal And on 10 September, 2013 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175499655/
